The rendered weather is a stage background; keep foreground action space unobstructed.

Do not redesign, reverse, crop, move or add openings to the building. Hold the original outer 16:9 frame. Change only the weather, light, and seasonal vegetation as specified. Clear crisp autumn moonlight in rich indigo blue against a soft pale moon just above the tile roof. Retain a few persimmons and yellow-orange leaves readable against blue. Only a gentle amber line of light through one lattice door from a small lamp and a delicate cool cast onto the dry swept yard. No snow, rain, star field or luminous highlights all over. Image 2 is light color guidance only.
